unproven.sentence: Hardware security keys, SMS MFA and trusted-device lists are not part of the current account contract, so they are not offered rather than silently ignored.
unproven.reason: Which second factors exist is decided at the identity provider, not in this repository, so nothing here can assert that a factor is absent. It stays unproven until the account contract enumerates the factors it accepts in code.

unproven.sentence: Managed cloud conversations are encrypted in transit and at rest.
unproven.reason: Encryption at rest is a property of the hosting provider's storage rather than of any statement this repository makes, so no assertion here can fail when it stops being true.

unproven.sentence: Server-side operational error reporting can run when configured and is not controlled by the browser setting.
unproven.reason: The claim is about an operator's deployment configuration rather than about code behaviour, and the deployment is not readable from the repository.

unproven.sentence: The number of custom MCP connections available depends on your plan.
unproven.reason: The plan catalogue is founder-frozen for this program, so no assertion is added against it; the limit is read from the catalogue at runtime and the pricing page is its published source.

unproven.sentence: **Lost the authenticator and every backup code.** There is no self-serve way back in, and there is no screen from which support can remove a second factor.
unproven.reason: No operator or support route touches user_two_factor: its writers are the holder's own routes under apps/web/app/api/settings/2fa, step-up verification and account erasure. Nothing in the repository asserts that absence, so it stays unproven until a guard enumerates every writer of that table.
